amanda_sales: Quick readout from Rainburst POC run. TL;DR: sustained ~1.2k qps for 512-token generation, p95 ~220ms, p99 ~480ms. With customer KMS+SSO enabled we saw ~30% higher p95 and more jitter. Full logs and heatmaps attached. Need pricing sketch + answers for their security questionnaire. cc @devon_soleng @ben_eng @hao_sre @claire_rainburst

ben_eng: Nice numbers. Can you drop the run config and the exact model variant?

amanda_sales: Here you go — run config used by our loadgen:
```
model: gptx-13b-quant-8bit
loadgen: rps_target: 1200
concurrency_target: 48
duration: 30m
input_tokens: 64
output_tokens: 448
batch_size_hint: 16
region: us-west-2
kv_cache: enabled
prefix_caching: warm
metrics: per-route latency, gpu_util, mem
```

deploy-bot: loadtest finished — 2025-02-15T10:21:13Z; total requests: 2,160,000; avg throughput: 1.2k rps; artifacts: s3://redwood-poc/rainburst/1745556667/

ben_eng: Observations: GPU utilization peaked ~78%, tail latency correlates with mixed crypto ops. When we flip quant->fp16 p95 drops ~10% but cost up ~20%. Suggested quick wins: increase batch_size_hint to 24 for steady traffic, enable more aggressive kv prefix caching for repeated prompts.

ben_eng: Rough cost sketch for their expected traffic (1.2k sustained, 30d):
- Hosted (on-demand): ~$18k/mo
- Dedicated (reserved pool sized for sustained + 2x headroom): ~$9k/mo base + ~$0.006 per 1k tokens for overage (net depends on commit)
These are ballpark — finance needs to confirm.

hao_sre: KMS note: customer-managed KMS in our VPC path adds ~30-40ms per token on average in our test. If they require HSM-backed keys there's an extra integration lead time. Suggestion: offer policy that falls back to Redwood-managed key for burst traffic to preserve SLOs, and use customer KMS for persisted artifacts. Also recommend Dedicated for guaranteed tail SLA.

claire_rainburst: Quick Q: if we go Dedicated can we keep p95 <= 250ms for 512 tokens with KMS on? Also what's the uplift to licensing to get 99.95% SLA?

amanda_sales: Claire — short answer: probably yes with Dedicated + 2x headroom and the fallback policy (we talked about). For pricing uplift to get SLA and enterprise support I put a quick sketch below (needs legal/finance sign-off):
- Dedicated reserved pool (sized for sustained 1.2k rps + headroom): $9,000/mo (monthly commit)
- Enterprise SLA & priority support add-on: $2,500/mo
- KMS/HSM integration professional services (one-time): $12k - $20k depending on scope
- Data residency / audit logs retention option: priced separately

devon_soleng: Security questionnaire — which items are open? I can take KMS integration design + provide the schema for key exchange.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire status: SSO (SAML/OIDC): complete; KMS integration: partial (questions 3,7 outstanding); Audit logs & retention: complete; Pen test certs requested: pending upload. Link: https://docs.internal/sec/rainburst-questionnaire

amanda_sales: @devon_soleng can you draft the KMS answers and confirm fallback behavior? Also @ben_eng please confirm the batch_size/quant tradeoffs for the numbers above so I can include them in the pricing justification.

ben_eng: Yup. I'll run a quick 1-hr sweep with batch_size 16/24/32 tomorrow morning and post delta. Expect ~5-12% latency improvement moving 16->24 on steady load.

hao_sre: Ops note: if we commit to Dedicated we should reserve cross-AZ capacity and add an autoscale buffer. Will prepare a runbook for canary rollover and fallback to hosted model if a zone goes down.

claire_rainburst: Thanks — can we get a clean summary doc for exec review? One-page: perf numbers, cost options (hosted vs dedicated), outstanding security items, timeline to HSM. Meeting to finalize next Tue morning?

amanda_sales: I’ll assemble the one-pager and the exec-ready slide. Targeting EOD Monday for draft. Meeting Tue 10am PT works. :thumbsup:

devon_soleng: I’ll own the KMS answers. ben will post sweep results by 09:00 PT tomorrow. hao will draft the runbook.

amanda_sales: Thanks team — moving this to next steps.

deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-poc/rainburst/1745556667/reports/summary.pdf

claire_rainburst: Great — see you Tue.

amanda_sales: Closing thread for now; will ping when slides are ready. :wave:
